name: inline-target
source:
from noscheme import role as r, net, use as u, num as n, std
component Part:
  params:
    number value = 1
  pins:
    1: r.passive
block B:
  global net.power vcc
block Unit:
  params:
    number count = 2
    number resistance = 4700
  ports:
    net.passive signal
  net.passive wire
  Part x(1: |)
